breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and periodic boundary conditions, which are contradictory for this problem. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes the Dirichlet boundary condition ('Use Dirichlet boundary conditions on all four edges: u = y on every boundary point.'), successfully resolving the inconsistency.
